sceneSentences.en: Lily played football with her friends in the park yesterday.
sceneSentences.zh: 莉莉昨天和朋友们在公园踢足球。

sceneSentences.source: 教材场景 · 改标不规则

sceneSentences.en: Jack and Chen Tao watched steam rise from a hotpot in winter.

sceneSentences.en: Miss Li and Mr Wang taught students in the library corner.

sceneSentences.en: Teng Fei walked slowly on the farm and fed the sheep fresh grass.
sceneSentences.zh: 腾飞在农场上慢慢走，喂羊吃新鲜草

sceneSentences.source: 教材场景 · 改标不规则

sceneSentences.en: Lily painted a blue sky with white clouds in the art room.
sceneSentences.zh: 莉莉在画室里画了一片蓝天上飘着白云

sceneSentences.zh: 汤姆在川剧变脸表演后打电话给朋友

sceneSentences.en: Emma ate a piece of cake and then ran to the playground.
sceneSentences.zh: 艾玛吃了一块蛋糕，然后跑向操场

sceneSentences.zh: 杰克从公园附近的小贩那里买了一个红气球

sceneSentences.en: Chen Tao wrote a letter to his grandmother with a blue pen.
sceneSentences.zh: 陈涛用蓝色钢笔给奶奶写了一封信

sceneSentences.en: Miss Li gave a big hug to the crying child in the classroom.
sceneSentences.zh: 李老师在教室里给了哭泣的孩子一个大大的拥抱

sceneSentences.en: Teng Fei did not climb the tall tree because he felt scared.
sceneSentences.zh: 腾飞没有爬那棵高树，因为他感到害怕

sceneSentences.en: Han Lin did not find his yellow umbrella after the rain stopped.
sceneSentences.zh: 雨停后，韩林没有找到他的黄色雨伞

sceneSentences.en: Did Linda wash the paintbrushes in the art room after painting.
sceneSentences.zh: 琳达画画后在画室里洗了画笔吗

sceneSentences.en: Lily and Tom flew a kite in the park when a sudden gust of wind snapped the string.

sceneSentences.en: Jack bought three boxes of fresh strawberries at the market, and the seller smiled warmly.
sceneSentences.zh: 杰克在市场买了三盒新鲜草莓，卖家热情地笑了。

sceneSentences.source: 教材改编 · 改标不规则

sceneSentences.en: They camped in a small tent near the lake, listening to the frogs croak all night.

sceneSentences.en: Chen Tao kicked the ball hard and scored a goal, making his teammates cheer loudly.

sceneSentences.en: Han Lin painted a beautiful lantern with red and yellow dragons for the festival.
sceneSentences.zh: 韩林为节日画了一个漂亮的红黄龙灯笼。

sceneSentences.en: Miss Li visited her grandpa and played chess with him, sipping hot tea slowly.

sceneSentences.source: 教材故事 · 改标规则

sceneSentences.en: Teng Fei lay on the grass and watched the stars, counting eleven in the dark sky.

sceneSentences.en: Mr Wang took a photo of a panda eating bamboo, and the panda blinked at him.
sceneSentences.zh: 王老师拍了一张熊猫吃竹子的照片，熊猫对他眨了眨眼。
sceneSentences.imageHint: 男人举相机，熊猫坐在地上啃竹子，背景有竹林

sceneSentences.en: The children acted out a short play in class, and Linda forgot her lines completely.
sceneSentences.zh: 孩子们在课堂上表演短剧，琳达完全忘了台词。

sceneSentences.en: Emma and Jack ate all the strawberries before dinner, feeling very guilty later.

sceneSentences.en: Tom did not finish his homework because his dog tore the paper into pieces.
sceneSentences.zh: 汤姆没有完成作业，因为他的狗把纸撕成了碎片。
sceneSentences.imageHint: 男孩看地上碎纸，狗摇尾巴，书桌凌乱

sceneSentences.en: The kite was not flying well in the rain, so Lily ran back home sadly.
sceneSentences.zh: 风筝在雨中飞不起来，莉莉伤心地跑回了家。

sceneSentences.en: Did Chen Tao score a goal during the match? No, he missed by a few inches.
sceneSentences.zh: 陈涛在比赛中进球了吗？没有，他差了几英寸没进。

sceneSentences.en: Was the little lantern finished before the festival? Yes, Han Lin stayed up late.
sceneSentences.zh: 小灯笼在节日前完成了吗？是的，韩林熬夜了。

sceneSentences.en: Yesterday, Miss Li bought a new chess set for her grandpa after work.
sceneSentences.zh: 昨天李老师下班后给爷爷买了一套新象棋。
sceneSentences.imageHint: 女人提着象棋盒，老人惊喜，客厅有钟显示下午六点

sceneSentences.en: The panda ate bamboo when Mr Wang pressed the camera button quietly.
sceneSentences.zh: 熊猫正在吃竹子时，王老师悄悄按下了相机按钮
sceneSentences.imageHint: 男人蹲着按快门，熊猫嘴叼竹子，阳光透过竹林
sceneSentences.source: 实际改编 · 改标不规则

sceneSentences.en: Teng Fei and Han Lin looked at the stars when a shooting star dashed across.

sceneSentences.en: Lily was proud after she won the sports day race yesterday.
sceneSentences.zh: 莉莉昨天运动会赛跑获胜后很自豪。
sceneSentences.imageHint: A girl in sports kit holding a small medal, smiling proudly on a school track

sceneSentences.en: The classroom was quiet during the reading contest last Friday.
sceneSentences.zh: 上周五阅读比赛时教室里很安静。
sceneSentences.imageHint: Quiet classroom, students reading books intently, soft window light

sceneSentences.en: Tom and Emma were hungry after the long hike last Sunday.
sceneSentences.zh: 汤姆和艾玛上周日长途徒步后很饿。
sceneSentences.imageHint: Two tired kids sitting on a rock with backpacks, eating sandwiches outdoors

sceneSentences.en: The hotpot was delicious at the Chengdu restaurant last night.
sceneSentences.zh: 昨晚成都火锅店的火锅很好吃。
sceneSentences.imageHint: Family around a steaming hotpot table with chili and vegetables, warm restaurant light

sceneSentences.en: Chen Tao was careful when he carried the volcano model to school.
sceneSentences.zh: 陈涛把火山模型带到学校时很小心。
sceneSentences.imageHint: Boy carefully carrying a science volcano model into school hallway

sceneSentences.en: Miss Li and the students were excited before the class play began.
sceneSentences.zh: 开演前李老师和同学们都很兴奋。
sceneSentences.imageHint: Teacher and kids in simple costumes waiting backstage, excited faces

sceneSentences.en: Lily went to the school library after class and found a funny storybook.
sceneSentences.zh: 莉莉下课后去了学校图书馆，找到了一本有趣的故事书。

matchPairs.en: Lily slipped on the wet floor and dropped her ice cream.
matchPairs.zh: 莉莉在湿滑的地板上滑倒，弄掉了她的冰淇淋。

matchPairs.en: Tom climbed the tall tree to rescue the frightened kitten.
matchPairs.zh: 汤姆爬上高大的树去救那只受惊的小猫。

matchPairs.en: Emma danced in the rain with her red umbrella spinning.
matchPairs.zh: 艾玛在雨中跳舞，她的红伞旋转着。

matchPairs.en: Jack packed his heavy backpack and left for the airport.
matchPairs.zh: 杰克收拾好沉重的背包，出发去了机场。

matchPairs.en: Chen Tao smiled proudly after winning the chess match.
matchPairs.zh: 陈涛在赢得象棋比赛后骄傲地笑了。

matchPairs.en: Miss Li carried a stack of books into the sunny classroom.
matchPairs.zh: 李老师抱着一摞书走进了阳光明媚的教室。

matchPairs.en: Mr Wang fixed the broken bicycle chain with a rusty wrench.
matchPairs.zh: 王先生用一把生锈的扳手修好了断掉的自行车链条。

matchPairs.en: Teng Fei cried bitterly when his goldfish floated belly-up.
matchPairs.zh: 腾飞在他的金鱼翻肚漂浮时伤心地大哭。

matchPairs.en: Han Lin baked a chocolate cake and burnt the frosting.
matchPairs.zh: 韩琳烤了一个巧克力蛋糕，但把糖霜烤焦了。

matchPairs.en: Linda wrapped the gift box with shiny silver paper and a bow.
matchPairs.zh: 琳达用闪亮的银纸和蝴蝶结把礼物盒包了起来。

matchPairs.en: The children laughed loudly as the clown juggled oranges.
matchPairs.zh: 小丑抛接橙子时，孩子们大声笑了起来。

matchPairs.en: The old man waved his hat and smiled at the passing train.
matchPairs.zh: 老人挥动帽子，对着经过的火车微笑。
